social.friends.heading: People on your trips
social.friends.intro: Everyone you share a trip with, travel companion or guest. You add people per trip: open a trip, tap the people icon and enter their @username.
social.friends.empty.title: Nobody yet
social.friends.empty.body: Ask your friends to create an account on this server, then add them to a trip.
social.traveller.notFound: This traveller doesn’t exist, or you don’t share a trip with them.
social.access.sendFailed: The request could not be sent
social.access.gone.title: This trip doesn’t exist
social.access.gone.body: The link no longer works, or the organiser has deleted the trip.
social.access.waitingNote: You’ll get a notification under Travellers once it’s answered.
social.access.denied: Your earlier request was declined. You’re welcome to ask again.
social.access.note: You’re not a travel companion or guest on this trip, so you can’t see the route or the photos. Ask {name} to let you in.
social.bell.label: Notifications
social.bell.empty: Nothing new. Requests and invitations show up here.
social.bell.approved: {name} can now follow along as a guest.
social.bell.loginAttempts: There have been many failed sign-in attempts.
social.bell.accountRequested: {who} would like an account on your server.
social.comments.title: Comments
social.comments.tooFast: Hold on, you're commenting a bit fast. Try again in a moment.
social.comments.sendFailed: Your comment was not sent. Try again.
social.comments.empty: No comments yet. Write the first one.
